description:
Call this to change how a published form behaves without touching its fields: webhook, email notifications, success message, redirect, or pause and resume. To change fields, publish a new version with publish_form and form_id instead. Changes the settings of a form of the account. Requires FORMHAUS_API_KEY to be an account key (fh_live_...); agent keys (fh_agent_..., also after a claim) get owner_key_required, and unclaimed forms are not found. Send only the settings to change; omitted ones stay. Returns form_id, status, success_message, redirect_url, notify_mode, webhook_url and a masked webhook_secret. Call reveal_webhook_secret for the full secret.

- webhook_url: public https:// URL that receives each new submission as a signed JSON POST {form_id, submission_id, version, values, created_at}. Private, loopback, link-local and cloud metadata addresses are refused. Setting a URL on a form without one creates a new signing secret. Empty string removes the webhook.
- notify_mode: "milestones" (default) emails the workspace members who turned on email notifications when the form reaches its 1st, 10th, 100th, 500th, 1,000th, 5,000th, 10,000th, 25,000th, 50,000th and 100,000th response; the emails hold a link to the responses and no response values. "off" sends nothing.
- success_message: text shown after a submission on the hosted page and embed, up to 500 characters.
- redirect_url: http(s) URL the hosted page and embed open after a submission. Empty string removes it.
- status: "paused" stops accepting submissions, "active" resumes. A form paused after abuse answers paused_by_moderation.

Example: {"form_id": "abcDEF1234", "webhook_url": "https://example.com/api/formhaus"}

The receiver checks the Formhaus-Signature header t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of t + "." + raw body, keyed with the full whsec_ secret>, rejects a t more than 5 minutes from now, compares in constant time and deduplicates by the Formhaus-Submission-Id header. On error, fix every listed setting and call again.

form_id.description: The 10-character form_id returned by publish_form or list_forms, such as "abcDEF1234".

notify_mode.description: milestones: an email at the 1st, 10th, 100th, 500th, 1,000th, 5,000th, 10,000th, 25,000th, 50,000th and 100,000th response, without response values. off: no emails. Omit to leave it unchanged.

redirect_url.description: http(s) URL the hosted page and embed open after a successful submission. Empty string removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

status.description: paused stops accepting submissions, active resumes them. Omit to leave it unchanged.

success_message.description: Text shown after a successful submission on the hosted page and embed. Up to 500 characters. Omit to leave it unchanged.

webhook_url.description: Public https:// URL that receives each new submission as a signed POST. Empty string removes the webhook. Omit to leave it unchanged.

name: update_form_settings

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the call failed.

title: Update form settings
